ui.labeledTranslation_android-dontkill: If Android aggressively kills notifications, check __(dontkillmyapp::link)__.
ui.labeledTranslation_android-step-2: Open the app and grant notification permissions (disable the battery optimization if prompted).
ui.labeledTranslation_android-step-3: Tap the 3 dots tab at the top
ui.labeledTranslation_android-step-6: Go back to the main menu
ui.labeledTranslation_android-step-7: Tap the green + button in the bottom right corner
ui.labeledTranslation_android-step-8: Subscribe to topic alphapings or swarmpings and let the Use another server toggle be off. The topics are lowercase.
ui.labeledTranslation_discord-bot-permissio: Note: The bot requires the "Embed Links", "Send Messages", and "View Channels" permissions to function.
ui.labeledTranslation_discord-bot-step-0: __('Language Notice:'::HTML::strong)__ The bot's interface and notifications are exclusively in English. To receive notifications in another language, please follow the __(webhooks_setup::link::ui)__ guide instead.
ui.labeledTranslation_discord-bot-step-2: Run the __('/server-settings'::HTML::code)__ command and configure the following:
ui.labeledTranslation_discord-bot-step-2a-d: Channel to post Alphas, Swarms, and Phenos
ui.labeledTranslation_discord-bot-step-2b-d: Enable/disable commands in the server and set the required role
ui.labeledTranslation_discord-bot-step-3: Optional: Set up custom notifications for calls from the __(profile_preferences::link::ui)__ page. Discord roles are mentioned using the format __('<@&role_ID>'::HTML::code)__ (e.g., __('<@&1234>'::HTML::code)__).
ui.labeledTranslation_ios-step-1: Install ntfy from the App Store
ui.labeledTranslation_ios-step-2: Open the app and grant notification permissions
ui.labeledTranslation_ios-step-3: Tap the Settings tab at the bottom
ui.labeledTranslation_ios-step-5: Go back to the notifications tab
ui.labeledTranslation_ios-step-7: Subscribe to topic alphapings or swarmpings and let the Use another server toggle be off. The topics are lowercase.
ui.labeledTranslation_publish-alpha-5: Find the Alpha you want to call out.
ui.labeledTranslation_publish-alpha-6: Click Publish, check the details and confirm. You can change the username attached to the post in the __(profile_preferences::link::ui)__ page. If you get the "__(not_logged::text::ui)__" error, log in with Discord from the navigation menu before publishing.
ui.labeledTranslation_publish-alpha-7: Want to help with publishing alphas? You have to call out at least 5 Swarms to become an Alpha Publisher. You can see your progress in the __(profile_preferences::link::ui)__ page.
ui.labeledTranslation_publish-discord-alpha:
Type the command and fill in any required parameters: __('/alpha-call'::HTML::code)__
__('(e.g., /alpha-call pokemon:Aggron region:Johto)'::HTML::em)__
ui.labeledTranslation_publish-discord-pheno:
Type the command and fill in any required parameters: __('/pheno-call'::HTML::code)__
__('(e.g., /pheno-call location:Abundant Shrine type:Grass)'::HTML::em)__
ui.labeledTranslation_publish-discord-prere: __('Prerequisite:'::HTML::strong)__ Server moderators must enable this functionality first. See the __(discord_bot_setup::link::ui)__ guide for details.
ui.labeledTranslation_publish-discord-swarm: Type one of the commands and fill in any required parameters:
__('/report-swarm'::HTML::code)__ to mark a Swarm as fake or ended early
__('/report-missing-spawn'::HTML::code)__ to make a request to add a missing Swarm
ui.labeledTranslation_publish-pheno-2: Search the pheno you found in game
ui.labeledTranslation_publish-pheno-3: Browse the maps if there are multiple available
ui.labeledTranslation_publish-pheno-4: Click copy with current map and post where ever you want to post it.
ui.labeledTranslation_publish-swarm-6: Find the Swarm you want to call out.
ui.labeledTranslation_publish-swarm-7: Click Publish, check the details and confirm. You can change the username attached to the post in the __(profile_preferences::link::ui)__ page. If you get the "__(not_logged::text::ui)__" error, log in with Discord from the navigation menu before publishing.
ui.labeledTranslation_publish-swarm-8: Want to help with publishing alphas? After calling out at least 5 Swarms you automatically become an Alpha Publisher. You can see your progress in the __(profile_preferences::link::ui)__ page.
ui.labeledTranslation_web-step-2: Allow notifications when your browser prompts you (left menu)
ui.labeledTranslation_web-step-3: Keep the browser tab open, or close it. Notifications will still be received.
ui.labeledTranslation_webhook-1: Visit the __(webhooks_dashboard::link::ui)__. You can easily reach that page from the __(profile_preferences::link::ui)__ page in the navigation menu.
ui.labeledTranslation_webhook-11: Your endpoint is now active and will now receive notifications. You can manage or delete it at any time, also can click test to see if it works!
ui.labeledTranslation_webhook-2: Click the Sign in with Discord button to authenticate your Discord account
ui.labeledTranslation_webhook-3: Authorize Alphapedia to access your Discord account, always check before you authorize anything if the redirect is to the alphapedia website.
ui.labeledTranslation_webhook-4: You'll be redirected to Webhooks Dashboard. Click the New Webhook button
ui.labeledTranslation_webhook-5: Now go to your Discord server/channel where you want Alphapedia to notify you of new Alphas
ui.labeledTranslation_webhook-6: Click the Integrations tab, and then click Webhooks. Click New Webhook
ui.labeledTranslation_webhook-7a: Name: A friendly name for your webhook (e.g., Alpha Pings)
ui.labeledTranslation_webhook-7b: Channel: The Discord channel where notifications will be sent (this is prefilled with the channel you edited)
ui.labeledTranslation_webhook-8: Don't forget to click Save Changes, and click Copy Webhook URL
ui.labeledTranslation_webhook-9: Now fill in the inputs as seen below:
ui.labeledTranslation_webhook-9a: Name: A label for this endpoint (optional, for your reference)
ui.labeledTranslation_webhook-9b: Target URL: Your webhook URL (e.g., Discord webhook URL or HTTP endpoint)
ui.labeledTranslation_webhook-9c: Post Language: The language for notifications sent to this endpoint
ui.labeledTranslation_webhook-9d: Notification Scope: Do you want to receive notifications for Alphas, Swarms, or both?
ui.labeledTranslation_webhook-9e: Message (optional): Custom message to include with notifications
ui.labeledTranslation_webhook-info-1: Webhooks allow you to send notifications to Discord and many other communication channels
ui.labeledTranslation_webhook-info-2: This does NOT work on the mobile app, only on the web and desktop versions of Discord.
